newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on HK holiday.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on HK holiday.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to remain mixed on Monday amid lacklustre trading on absence of foreign players due to a holiday in Hong Kong on the eve of its handover to Beijing, dealers said on Monday.
"The holiday in Hong Kong means slow activity," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan of BMA Capital Management said.
She said some local institutions would also remain on sidelines because of their June 30 financial year-end.
On Friday, the Karachi 100-index fell 8.22 points, or 0.52 percent, to 1,571.27 amid 154 losers and 88 gainers.
